    The stages are simply connected (Fischbacher, Lemmas 2.2 and 2.4, cocycle form) #

    For a cocycle c on a stage Y_K, walks of P' = P/⟨αᵢ⟩ act on pairs (point of the cover over their start, integer) by lifting arrows and adding the c-weights of the lifted arrows (liftAct); homotopies of P' lift, so this is an action of the fundamental groupoid of P' (liftAct_sound). It transports the equalities of classes in Lemma 2.1's data to equalities of weights in Y_K.
